metaTitle: How Many Watts Do You Need for Camping?
description: Work out how many watts and watt-hours you need for camping, with tables of real device loads, surge allowances and sizing by camping style.
directAnswer: Most campers need 300 to 1,000 W of output and 300 to 1,200 Wh a day. Watts set what you can run at once, watt-hours set how long, and heat-making devices like kettles and air conditioners push you toward generators.
